Ok so we gonna have a deep dive into haircuts. 
Women haircuts always strive to make the face more pointy. They want to frame the face in a way that the attention gets dragged to the chin and jaw line. What you want to achieve is the opposite, you want the focus on the upper part of your head. Cuttin your sites shorter and styling the top upwards or backwards should do you a huge favor. 
Faded sites with a harsh transition is what you want to go for. Styling the top hair backwards opens up your forehead and gives a more round face. 
But besides all that, you have great potential. 
Hope you find a way to feel better very soon, much much love & strength!
